seoTitle: About the firm and team | Capital Row
seoDescription: Capital Row is an M&A firm for vertical software. Why we exist, how we work, and the operators, clinicians and advisors on each engagement.

items.text: Capital Row is the M&A firm for software the working economy cannot switch off. We help buyers identify software businesses that fit their acquisition strategy, build relationships with owners, and assess opportunities before a letter of intent.
For owners, we show what a buyer will find in the numbers while there is still time to change it.

Every engagement runs the same way. The intelligence comes before the introduction.
The sector is mapped before anyone goes to market: the companies in it, the buyers active in it, and where its deals break.
What a buyer buys, in writing: sector, size and structure. Kept on file and confirmed each quarter.
Each opportunity is set against the criteria on file. A buyer hears about the ones that fit.
Before a letter of intent, the numbers are traced to source documents and every adjustment is marked supported or unsupported.
Capital Row acts for one side of the transaction, under a scope agreed in writing.

sections.name: The report behind the price, read before the buyer reads it.

items.text: The numbers, traced before the letter of intent.

For a buyer, we trace a target’s reported earnings to source documents and mark each adjustment supported or unsupported before a letter of intent, so diligence starts from evidence instead of a pitch.
For an owner, the Sell-Side QoE puts the same evidence on the owner’s side of the table, prepared with the independent firms we partner with, before any buyer reads the numbers.
Operators, clinicians and transaction advisors, working together on each engagement. Tap or click a card to read the bio.

Shawnee founded Capital Row and leads its healthcare desks. She is an M&A advisor and a healthcare operator. She helped scale a private equity-backed healthcare platform from roughly 6,000 to 22,000 employees and built the post-close integration model for Keck Medicine of USC across more than 45 clinics. That work put her on the customer side of healthcare software, among the providers whose billing, scheduling and records systems a buyer is paying for. Her transaction experience covers behavioral health, home health, hospice and physician services, and her career includes academic medicine and private equity-backed healthcare systems.
Dennis Nelson directs operations at Capital Row and leads its transportation and logistics desks.

Dr. Benjamin is a psychiatrist and clinical leader with more than two decades in mental health treatment, clinician training, and program development. He served 21 years in the U.S. Air Force, including as Medical and Administrative Director of the Tinker Air Force Base Substance Abuse Program, and has held leadership roles at Ventura County Behavioral Health and the Oklahoma City VA. He specializes in psychiatric collaboration, trauma-informed care, and high-acuity conditions, and has published more than 30 research articles and books.

Dan is a licensed Marriage and Family Therapist with more than 45 years in behavioral health program development and clinician training. He founded Praxes Behavioral Health, has launched more than 250 behavioral health programs, and has trained more than 5,000 professionals. He led a Long Beach outpatient agency’s growth from 11 to 75 employees and from $2 million to $7 million in revenue, and helps organizations secure funding for program growth.

items.text:
You know the sector.
We bring the buyers, the tools and the platform.
Capital Row is building its bench: M&A advisors, technology managing directors and founders who have sold a software company, each covering a sector they know from the inside.
You know software in one of our twelve industries, from operating or building a company in it or from transactions closed in it, and you can say when a business needs more preparation first.
Buyer criteria on file, sector intelligence and a quality of earnings tool for buy-side work, so you assess a target from evidence before the letter of intent.
Keep your own name and grow your practice brand with the reach of the Capital Row network behind it.
Send a short note on the sector you cover, or see both ways to join.
